modeAskHint: Claude asks before editing files or running commands; answer with the buttons.
modeEditsHint: Claude edits project files without asking; commands and other risky actions are asked with buttons.
modeFullHint: Any files, commands and internet access without asking. Use with care.
botDescription: Remote control for Duet on your computer. Write a task and Claude Code runs it in your project, shows live progress and asks before risky actions. Only the owner's account is obeyed.
botShortDescription: Run Claude Code tasks on your computer from Telegram.
welcome: 👋 Duet is connected. Write a task in plain text and Claude will run it on your computer. Use the menu below to pick a project or a chat and to change settings.
help: Duet remote control Write a task in plain text: Claude runs it on your computer as a regular chat in the current project (it is live in the Duet app too), shows progress here with a ⏹ Stop button and sends back the answer. Menu 📁 Projects: pick where Claude works 💬 Chats: continue a recent chat ➕ New chat: the next message starts a new chat ⚙️ Settings: permission mode, model, notifications 📊 Status: what's selected and whether a task is running Permissions In the Ask and Allow edits modes Claude asks before risky actions: answer with ✅ Allow, ✅ Always allow or ❌ Deny, here or in the app. No answer within 10 minutes means Deny. Files Send a photo or a document (up to 20 MB) with a caption: it is saved into the project and Claude reads it with your task. Commands: /menu /projects /chats /new /settings /status /stop /help
homeHint: Write a task and Claude will run it here.
homeBusy: ⏳ A task is running right now.
fullConfirm: Claude will be able to run any command and change any file without asking. Turn it on?
projectPicked: ✨ The next message starts a new chat in this project.
